name: Hyakki Rinne
source:
In the era of great wars between Yokai (Monster) and Onmyoji (Exorcist), you are named to become the lord of all Yokai. For the Yokai followers, you devote all your powers to the battle, but it's a matter of time until you realize your special feelings towards a few...

[From StoryMe]
translation:
在妖怪与阴阳师大战的时代，你被任命为所有妖怪的领主。对于妖怪追随者来说，你将所有的力量都投入到战斗中，但你迟早会意识到自己对某些人的特殊感情……

[来自故事我]
